answer: Identity Rarity Auctions. Each identity is admitted by auctioning a scarce, time-bound resource slot whose supply is fixed per region; bids are public and non-refundable, converting sybil creation into a contested-price race. A pearl of verified history unlocks renewal, while balances sit in a vault until the slot expires. Losing bidders' refunds are delayed, and a plume of reputational weight transfers only on clean exit. Attackers pay escalating slot prices plus locked capital per fake identity.
